tool.name: parse_openapi_spec
tool.description: Parse an OpenAPI 3 / Swagger 2 spec supplied as JSON and list its endpoints with methods, parameters, and auth requirements.

parameters.parameter: OpenAPI/Swagger spec as a JSON string.

tool.name: analyze_api_auth
tool.description: Run BOLA (two-account diff), BFLA (role diff), and JWT hygiene checks on supplied response fixtures. No network access.

parameters.parameter: Response dict JSON for account A.
Response dict JSON for account B.
HTTP status for the low-privilege BFLA probe.

tool.name: scan_secrets_text
tool.description: Scan text for hardcoded secrets (AWS keys, private keys, tokens) and return redacted findings. Secrets are never echoed in full.

tool.name: check_container_config
tool.description: Audit Dockerfile content (exposed ports, secrets, root user) and a TLS config fixture (min version, cert expiry). No network access.
